emailSubject: FMB News | DFA Confirms 8 Filipino Teachers Safe After Thailand School Shooting | August 8, 2026 | 12:00 PM PHT
headline: Eight Filipino Teachers Safe After Thailand School Shooting
deck: The Philippine Embassy in Bangkok said all eight registered Filipino teachers at Debsirin School Nonthaburi were safe, accounted for, and uninjured after the August 7 shooting.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Philippine Embassy in Bangkok confirmed that all eight registered Filipino teachers working at Debsirin School Nonthaburi were safe, accounted for, and uninjured after a deadly shooting at the school on August 7, 2026.

sections.heading: What we know
paragraphs: The embassy said no Filipino teacher or citizen was harmed in the incident. It remained on standby to provide assistance through official channels and continued monitoring the situation.

The school is in Nonthaburi province on the outskirts of Bangkok. Reuters reported that a teenage student opened fire at the school after fatally shooting his grandparents. Police said teachers and staff were among those killed and that other people were wounded.
The final toll and other details remained subject to updates from Thai authorities.

sections.heading: Background
paragraphs: The Philippine Embassy in Thailand issued its safety confirmation after contacting the Filipino community connected to the school. Philippine diplomatic posts provide consular assistance to nationals affected by emergencies abroad.

sections.heading: What remains unclear
paragraphs: Thai authorities were continuing to establish the full sequence of events, the final casualty count, and the circumstances that led to the attack.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The embassy's confirmation gives the teachers' families and the wider Filipino community an official account of their safety while Thai authorities investigate a rapidly developing security incident.

sections.heading: What happens next
paragraphs: The Philippine Embassy will continue monitoring official Thai updates and remains available to provide necessary assistance through its official channels.
